ticket.title: Implement Institute-wide evaluator access with assessment constraints

user_story.i_want: evaluators to access all Institute AAR records with appropriate constraints
user_story.so_that: evaluators have workflow flexibility while maintaining data integrity

sub_tasks.summary: Set AAR object-wide default sharing to ...

scope_notes: BH-1010 absorbs the scope of BH-1011 (closed as thin duplicate, Mar 2026). This is the SINGLE story covering all evaluator security configuration: OWD, sharing rules, public groups, FLS, and permission sets.
Engineers should NOT look to BH-1011 for any additional scope.

access.condition: Status = Submitted, Under Review, or Complete

access.object: All AAR records within their Institute
access.notes: Scope gated by Account relationship — see sharing rule

sharing_rules.name: Institute_Evaluators_AAR_Access
sharing_rules.status_filter: NONE — evaluators see Draft, In Progress, Submitted, all statuses
sharing_rules.alignment_note: Per Apr 24, 2026 decision: use the same Experience Cloud sharing pattern as FCC access. The Account lookup is the single scope gate — one rule covers directors, business managers, AND evaluators assigned to that Institute. No separate criteria-based rule per persona is needed.

validation_rules.name: VR_Evaluator_Assessment_Status
validation_rules.error_message: Evaluator assessment can only be completed for Submitted AARs.
validation_rules.purpose: Evaluators can VIEW incomplete AARs but cannot ASSESS until Status = Submitted

automated_membership.action: Add Contact's User to AAR_Evaluators public group via Apex invocable or Flow action
automated_membership.deprecation_note: Per Apr 24, 2026 decision: do NOT use Process Builder (deprecated). Use Record-Triggered Flow instead.

security_notes: Evaluators can VIEW incomplete AARs but cannot ASSESS until Status = Submitted
Read-only access prevents accidental data modification
Audit trail captures all evaluator record access

decision_log.decision: Meeting authority: evaluator access model and assessment constraints confirmed
BH-1010 absorbs BH-1011 (closed as thin duplicate). BH-1010 is the single story for all evaluator security config.
Align with FCC Experience Cloud sharing pattern — Account relationship is the single scope gate for directors, business managers, and evaluators. No per-persona criteria-based rules.
Replace Process Builder (deprecated) with Record-Triggered Flow for AAR_Evaluators public group membership automation.
